title: 四级长对话：陶艺课程与行李箱退换
instruction: 听完整一节两段长对话及各段后读出的问题，依次选择最佳答案。音频中材料和问题各读一遍，卷面只印四个选项。本原创使用节内编号1—8，各段对应1—4、5—8题。播放器可回听，正式单次听辨条件未强制。
audio_introduction: Section B. You will hear two long conversations. After each, you will hear questions. Each recording and each question will be spoken only once. Choose the best answer from A, B, C and D.
source_form_notice: 四级形式参照2024年12月第一套转载Section B：2段、4/4共8回应、每题四选；原创采用节内编号，问题只在录音与作者区。全部自有虚构内容及本机合成试听，非原考试原声；未独立教研/听辨/学生难度或产品等值验证。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Hello, I'm interested in the pottery classes advertised in your window. I've never made anything from clay before. Would the Saturday workshop be suitable?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It is open to beginners, but that one is mainly for people who want to decorate a ready-made bowl. If you want to learn to shape clay yourself, the four-week evening course would be better.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I had assumed the evening course was for experienced students. The photograph showed some very impressive pots.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Those were made by the tutor. Everyone starts with a simple cup. We keep the group small so the tutor can show each person what to do.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That sounds closer to what I want. I work until six, though. What time does it begin?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: At seven. The studio is open from six thirty if you want to arrive early, but teaching starts at seven.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: And do I need to buy any equipment before the first class?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. Tools and enough clay for the course are included. Bring an apron or wear clothes you don't mind getting dirty. If you want extra clay later, you can buy it here.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: My sister might come too, but she can't manage the final evening. Would she lose the piece she makes?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not at all. The last meeting is for discussing the finished work after it has been fired. She could collect hers the following week. She would miss that discussion, but the firing is included in her fee.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good. I'll check with her tonight rather than book two places straight away.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That's fine. I can hold two places until tomorrow afternoon without payment.

questions.spoken_question: Why does the man suggest the evening course?
options: It is the only class with places still available.
It teaches students to shape clay themselves.
It is designed for people with several years of experience.
It allows students to decorate bowls without making them.
questions.rationale: B：晚课教shape clay；A未说周六满；C初学可参加；D是周六装饰现成碗，不是晚课理由。

questions.spoken_question: What does the man say about the photograph?
options: It shows work produced by the tutor.
It was taken during a Saturday workshop.
It shows what every beginner must complete first.
It advertises equipment that students need to purchase.
questions.rationale: A：those were made by tutor；B未给拍摄场次；C入门先做简单杯，非照片精美罐；D非购物清单。

questions.spoken_question: What must participants provide for the course?
options: Their own tools and enough clay for four weeks.
A finished cup to discuss at the first meeting.
An extra payment before every piece is fired.
An apron or clothes suitable for getting dirty.
questions.rationale: D：自带围裙或可弄脏衣物；A工具材料含费；B从零做杯；C烧制已含费，不是逐件另付。

questions.spoken_question: What will the woman do next?
options: Pay immediately to secure two places.
Collect her sister's completed work from the studio.
Speak to her sister before confirming the booking.
Ask the tutor to move the final class to another week.
questions.rationale: C：今晚先问姐姐/妹妹再订；A目前可无付款保留；B作品尚未制作；D只可之后取件，无改课请求。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I bought this suitcase here last Friday, and one of the wheels has stopped turning. I'd like to exchange it before I travel tomorrow.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt with you?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, here it is. I haven't actually taken it on a trip yet. I noticed the problem when I was packing this morning.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I can see that the wheel is stuck. We normally offer an exchange or a refund for a fault like this. Unfortunately, we don't have another one of this size in the same color.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Color isn't important, but I do need the same size. It has to fit the airline's cabin allowance.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: There is a blue version at our branch across town. I could ask them to keep it for you. Or we have this larger case here at the same price.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The larger one won't help. I'm traveling with hand luggage only. Could the other branch send the blue one here today?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Our delivery van has already left, so we couldn't promise that. But I can arrange for you to exchange it there, with this receipt.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I won't be able to get across town before they close. I think I'd better take a refund and find another case nearer my office.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Certainly. Did you pay by card?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. Will the money go back immediately?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We can process the refund now, but it may take a few working days to appear in your account. You'll receive a refund receipt today.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: All right. I understand. I'll keep that receipt until the payment appears.

questions.spoken_question: When did the man discover the problem with the suitcase?
options: While returning from a trip across town.
While he was packing that morning.
After exceeding the airline's luggage allowance.
questions.rationale: C：packing this morning；A未乘该箱出行；B无此旅行；D尺寸合规是换箱要求，非发现故障原因。

questions.spoken_question: Why does the man reject the larger case?
options: It does not suit his hand-luggage plans.
It costs much more than the original.
It has the same faulty wheel.
questions.rationale: B：只带随身行李、需原尺寸；A明确颜色无所谓；C同价；D未称新大箱有故障。

questions.spoken_question: Why can the woman not promise delivery from the other branch that day?
options: The customer has lost the original receipt.
The other branch has sold its last blue case.
The airline has changed its cabin allowance.
The delivery vehicle has already departed.
questions.rationale: D：van has already left；A有小票；B蓝色有货；C无航空规则变化。

questions.spoken_question: What does the woman explain about the refund?
options: The money may take several working days to reach his account.
He must visit the other branch to receive it.
The store will issue only a shopping voucher.
The store cannot start processing it until next week.
questions.rationale: A：现在办理、入账数个工作日；B可本店；C原卡退款非购物券；D无须等下周处理。
